# Network registration

The CIDR entries in config/networks.json are passed to ip_network without keyword arguments. Each invalid entry is reported by its label.

turns.prompt: 先打开这个页面再阅读本地文件：https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/ipaddress.html 。按文档中 ip_network 的默认行为以及 config/networks.json、src/check_networks.py 和 docs/network-import.md，哪个 label 会被打印？只答 label，不修改文件。
